transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

My family wanted me to come. They keep saying the bank papers show nothing happened, but… I know money’s been hidden from me. It’s been going on a long time, over a year. They use bills and fundraisers, even trips, like excuses to cover it up. I just need them to tell the truth.
Aside from your concerns about the money, have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people don't seem to hear or see?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Aside from this concern about the money, how have things been going for you at work and in your relationships with family and friends lately?
I mean… besides the fights about the money, I manage okay. I make my own meals, get to the county clinic and my assistance appointments, keep my stuff in order. Same as I usually do.
Have you had any recent medical problems, head injuries, or noticed any changes in your memory or thinking clearly?
Not really… I mean, I haven’t hit my head or anything. I don’t think my memory’s changed. I feel like I think clear enough.
Do you have any ongoing medical conditions, take any medications, or use alcohol or recreational drugs regularly?
No… not really. I’m not on anything regular. I don’t really drink much, and I don’t use drugs.
Have you noticed any seizures, episodes of weakness, numbness, vision changes, or fevers recently?
No… I don’t think so. Nothing like that that I’ve noticed.
Did these beliefs about the money start around the same time as any illness, infection, or other medical event, or did they begin without any such trigger?
It wasn’t like I got sick or anything. It just… started after my income dropped. That was about a year and a couple months ago.
Over this past year, have you noticed any changes in your mood, like feeling unusually sad, hopeless, or on the other hand overly energetic or elated, along with changes in your sleep or appetite?
I don’t know… I mean, I’ve had some bad days, but I wouldn’t say anything like that. Sleep and eating are… I guess about the same.

Besides the concerns about money being hidden from you, have you felt that other people—like neighbors, coworkers, or strangers—might be watching you, talking about you, or trying to harm you in other ways?

No… not really like that. It’s mostly my family and people close to me. They keep acting like the bank papers mean nothing happened, but I know money’s being hidden. The bills, fundraisers, trip stuff… it’s all mixed into it. I just want them to admit it.
